prompt: Create ONE unique transparent PNG illustration for the indicated LeetCode problem, using the attached images strictly as character and visual STYLE REFERENCES, not as a collage to copy. Sparse flat 2D cartoon sketch, slightly irregular teal outlines, cream round heads, dot eyes, soft geometric bodies, thin limbs. Female has teal ponytail, curved forelock, peach shirt; male has short teal tuft, mustard shirt. Same recurring duo, proportions and simple faces as references. Cream/peach/mustard/mint palette, blue only where useful. Reference characters must remain recognizable; accessories may vary. Layout MUST be one LONG SHALLOW HORIZONTAL STRIP, about 6:1 content aspect ratio, e.g. 1536x256. If canvas must be taller, keep artwork in central shallow strip with TRANSPARENT unused margins so it can be trimmed. NO background, no white rectangle, no checkerboard, genuine alpha throughout empty space including between objects. Opaque interiors. No panel borders or speech bubbles, no scenery, gradients, 3D or photorealism. Keep a few prominent task objects and one or two small characters. Minimal text; no title, captions, solution steps, algorithm diagrams or explanatory formulas. Illustrate premise, not solving strategy. Strong enough strokes to be legible on light AND dark UI. Leave safe padding and do not clip objects. Specific scene: 165 Compare Version Numbers. Female detective and male in mustard shirt face each other across two large cream software-version plaques reading exactly "1.2" and "1.10". Between plaques a simple small comparison balance indicator with left plaque lower in VALUE? Avoid physical scales: instead just a small question mark between plaques, no output or relation given. Male holds a small magnifying glass toward dotted segments. A few mint dots connect each plaque to tiny software-package icon. No algorithm or numeric answer; show version comparison task only. All figures safely inside margins.
